amends.amendment_type: clarification of two provenance pointers, not a correction of the verdict or the winner

adapter_manifest_sha256.note: The manifest was rewritten by the rebuild, so the pre-rebuild file digest names no file.

finding.cause: The receipt was sealed at e511252. The next commit, 3864bfc, replaced the render provenance implementation -- it now digests Git blob identity rather than on-disk bytes -- and the frontier manifest was rebuilt under the new implementation. Both sealed pointers were computed before that rebuild.
finding.issue: Two identities sealed into the frontier receipt no longer resolve to anything.

render_provenance_digest.note: Same declared paths and same member count; only the algorithm changed.

lesson: A receipt should cite an identity that survives re-execution. Canonical PCM, score and contract identities did; a digest of a rebuilt manifest file and a digest computed by a since-replaced algorithm did not. The same lesson was recorded privately for the render receipts at promotion time, and it applies to public receipts too.

what_remains_verified.note: Content-addressed identities survived the rebuild unchanged. The audition, the verdict and the winner are unaffected.
